_comment: CCI classification reference data, restructured to match NBS Nordic's own component field names (classificationcode / classificationserial / classificationname) instead of the source PDF's Danish terms, so it can be matched directly against real /components API responses.
_source: Region Syddanmark — IKT klassifikation og identifikationsliste, dateret 2023-07-12
_classification_system_hint: CCI-compatible. NBS Nordic projects can use different classification systems (seen in live data: BIM7AA v.2.1, BIM7AA v.3.2, CCI Bygningsdele R1, CCS Bygningsdele R1) — verify a project's actual classification_system_name via nbs_get_project before treating these codes as valid for it. Do not assume universal applicability.
